title: Needs better organization
text:
App LOOKS great.. but it’s missing some important budgeting features..

1) you need the ability to GROUP categories… I should be able to make a Housing Group that has Mortgage category, utilities category, lawn maintenance category, etc..

Simply having just the category layer isn’t good enough because it’s just a long list of things with no organization. 


2) need to be able to have a budget TEMPLATE for each month.. BUT once the template starts for each month, I should be able to edit and change the budget for THAT month while keeping the budget template the same for the next month. A change in the budget in October shouldn’t change the entire budget template. This is important because each month’s expenses can be different.


Once you make these two changes, this will be the best app!

title: Very pretty but lacks depth
text: I like how it looks. I even gave a start for proving a single one time purchase than reoccurring. However it lacks so many categories. Like car healthcare, dentist. Can’t use the symbol for overhead (like car), and make smaller things like gas underneath. Maybe it’s in the purchased version. But I can only judge by the free trial.

title: Inconsistent
text:
I downloaded this app before it even had 1,000 reviews and paid $2.99 for premium. Now, starting fresh with a new account, premium is $25.99. The ads are also overwhelming, taking up more than half the screen when you open the app.

I tried transferring access from my old account, but it didn’t work. What really turned me off was customer support denying the original price despite having receipts, along with unnecessarily short, dismissive responses.

I was willing to overlook the bugs and ongoing issues, but poor customer service made the decision easy. I simply deleted the app. I don’t support businesses that make customers feel undervalued.

title: Useless without purchase
text: Without purchase you can only add categories. Even setting reoccurring transactions is blocked behind a 25.99 purchase. I couldn’t test the app beyond that because the purchase popup is so aggressive. Don’t download unless you’re positive you want to buy it. I like the theme and wanted to like the app but the paywall is so restrictive I don’t think it’s right to list this as just in-app purchases.
